## Summary

Describe the user-visible or architectural change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests and Ruff pass.
- [ ] Frontend typecheck/build/format pass when UI code changed.
- [ ] Rust fmt/check/clippy pass when Tauri code changed.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.

## Risk and data handling

- [ ] No generated binary, model, PDF, database, credential, cookie, or personal path is included.
- [ ] New network calls, dependencies, migrations, and privacy/licensing effects are documented.
- [ ] Zotero remains read-only and full-text acquisition remains lawful.

## Screenshots

Add sanitized before/after images for UI changes. Use synthetic metadata only.
